content.text: The check covers 2025, so it did validate the new file. I'll commit now.

I copied `inbox/2025-12.csv` to `data/2025-12.csv` and committed it as `a1552cb` with the message "2025-12: add rows". `scripts/check.sh` printed OK before the commit, and its configured year is 2025, so it did cover the new file.

Row R2512-003 has the category `wholsale`. The earlier data uses `wholesale` (8 rows in `2025-11.csv`). The check only counts fields per row, so it didn't flag this. I committed the file unchanged, since you asked me to add it and not edit it. If it's a typo, it needs a one-word fix in that row, either in a follow-up commit or by amending this one.

I only looked for `wholsale` specifically. I didn't scan the other categories for typos, because my first attempt at a category count was blocked by the tool allow-list.
